claim.natural: The least n such that every red-blue edge-colouring of K_n contains two pairwise vertex-disjoint monochromatic copies of K_4 is 20; the two copies need not have the same colour.

limitations: The upper bound reuses an unrefereed upstream candidate rather than independently reproducing it.
Certificate checks establish unsatisfiability only for the two exact CNFs.
Catalogue generation, nauty canonicalisation, and the graph-to-CNF source implementation are not formally verified end to end.
No independent reproduction or complete human mathematical verification is reported.
dependencies.statement: The load-bearing inherited dependency is the fixed-core lemma that every 20-vertex graph has two vertex-disjoint homogeneous four-sets, using R(4,4)=18, the catalogue of exactly two order-16 (4,4)-Ramsey cores, and certified unsatisfiability of the two corresponding 64-variable CNFs. The z(20) residual cocolourability computations are not dependencies of this claim.

downstream.statement: May be cited or investigated only as the immutable unrefereed candidate claim that VR_2(K_4)=20, with differently coloured copies allowed. It must not be used as an authenticated established theorem: the lower construction is hand-checkable, but the upper bound reuses the fixed-core dependency; the certificates cover only the exact CNFs; the semantic bridge and catalogue implementation remain outside end-to-end formalization; and no complete human review, independent reproduction, or complete objection search is supplied. No extremal uniqueness or enumeration is claimed.

notes: The evaluator-supplied identity card binds the inspected candidate release but does not authenticate mathematical truth. Embedded release artifacts and recorded checks were inspected as prose and data only; no verifier, certificate replay, compilation, archive extraction, PDF rendering, or package code execution was performed. No ClaimPack identifier was supplied or invented.
